description: Sends any one of eight inputs to a single output, picked by a button press or a gate rather than by stepping in order

params.text: Pressing this sends the input of the same number to the OUT jack, the change happening at the start of the press

inputs.text: Sent to the OUT jack while that input is the one picked
A rising edge above 2V sends the input of the same number to the OUT jack; the button for that input goes on working while a cable is patched here

outputs.text: Carries whichever of the eight inputs is currently picked
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time the selection changes; selections closer together than 1ms stretch the pulse rather than each firing their own

notes: one channel only; this module does not handle polyphonic signals
